# Test that -race works with CGO_ENABLED=bindings and no C toolchain,
# and that it still requires cgo with CGO_ENABLED=0.

env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
[!GOEXPERIMENT:cgobindings] skip
[!race] skip
[short] skip

[!GOOS:windows] env CC=/bin/false
[GOOS:windows] env CC=nonexistent-cc
env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
! go run -race racy.go
stderr 'WARNING: DATA RACE'

# On macOS, -race does not require cgo.
[GOOS:darwin] stop
env CGO_ENABLED=0
! go build -race racy.go
stderr '^go: -race requires cgo; enable cgo by setting CGO_ENABLED=1 or CGO_ENABLED=bindings$'

-- racy.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 0
	done := make(chan bool)
	go func() {
		x = 1
		done <- true
	}()
	x = 2
	<-done
	fmt.Println(x)
}
